name: Salzburger Stube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Salzburger Stube in Tirol**

Discover the warm, traditional charm of Salzburg in the heart of Tirol! Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor authentic Austrian cuisine with a touch of Alpine flair. Indulge in hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Apfelstrudel**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all prepared with local ingredients.

After your meal, relax with a **Schnaps** or a cup of **Kaffee und Kuchen** while enjoying the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're visiting **Innsbruck**, exploring the **Zillertal**, or skiing in **St. Anton**, our Salzburger Stube is your perfect retreat for a taste of home—no matter where you roam in Tirol.

Come experience the best of Salzburg’s hospitality in the stunning landscapes of Tirol!
